start.args:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, signal, subprocess, time
N = int("800")
CYCLE_MS = int("100")
SECS = float("20")
MAX = float("2.0")
EP, XML, OUT = "tcp://127.0.0.1:5599", "/tmp/burger-bench.xml", "/tmp/burger-bench.json"
res = {"tags": N, "window_s": SECS, "max_cycle_s": MAX, "requests": 0,
       "tag_writes": 0, "probe_writes": 0, "seconds_per_cycle": None, "error": None}
fd = None
try:
    import zmq
    tags = "".join(f"<external-tag><name>p{i}</name><io>O{i}</io><type>analog</type></external-tag>" for i in range(N))
    outs = "".join(f"<analog><id>O{i}</id><name>p{i}</name></analog>" for i in range(N))
    logic = "\n".join(f"p{i} = p{i} + 1" for i in range(N))
    open(XML, "w").write(f'<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><SCEPTRE><field-device><name>bench-1</name><cycle-time>{CYCLE_MS}</cycle-time><tags>{tags}</tags><output><endpoint>{EP}</endpoint>{outs}</output><logic><![CDATA[\n{logic}\n]]></logic></field-device></SCEPTRE>')
    rep = zmq.Context().socket(zmq.REP)
    rep.bind(EP)
    env = dict(os.environ, BENNU_LOG_LEVEL="INFO")
    fd = subprocess.Popen(["bennu-field-device", "--file", XML], env=env,
                          stdout=open("/tmp/burger-bench-fd.log", "w"), stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
    first, stamps, t0 = None, [], time.time()
    while True:
        now = time.time()
        if first is None and now - t0 > 60:
            res["error"] = "no WRITE reached the responder in 60 s"
            break
        if first is not None and now - first > SECS:
            break
        if not rep.poll(500):
            continue
        op, _, payload = rep.recv().rstrip(b"\0").decode().partition("=")
        if op.upper() == "WRITE":
            first = first or time.time()
            pts = [p.split(":")[0] for p in payload.split(",") if p]
            res["requests"] += 1
            res["tag_writes"] += len(pts)
            if "p0" in pts:
                stamps.append(time.time())
        rep.send(b"ACK=ok\0")
    gaps = [b - a for a, b in zip(stamps, stamps[1:])]
    res["probe_writes"] = len(stamps)
    res["seconds_per_cycle"] = sum(gaps) / len(gaps) if gaps else None
except Exception as e:
    res["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
finally:
    if fd:
        fd.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
        try:
            fd.wait(10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            fd.kill()
    json.dump(res, open(OUT, "w"))
    print(json.dumps(res))
PY
